_trace.query: buffered events lost late listener onWillAddFirstListener
_trace.looking_for: an issue reporting that events fired before a listener subscribes are silently dropped/lost, or asking for visibility into which events use event buffering

_trace.why: None of these concern a buffered-event emitter dropping events for a listener that attaches late via onWillAddFirstListener.

none of these concern an Emitter/event-buffering-before-listener-attached bug, they're about revival cancellation, PR context pills, chat mini map events, word wrapping, editor sorting, Copilot output duplication, automations rerender, and websocket hang

_trace.action: read the real source and judged
_trace.why: event.ts adds a reportBufferedOnFirstListener callback invoked only when onDidAddFirstListener fires with buffer.length>0, i.e. exactly when a late listener causes a non-empty buffer flush; tests confirm it fires with the buffered count on late attach and not on empty buffer. ipc.ts wires this into fromService via a settable bufferUsageReporter that reports (serviceName, eventName, bufferedCount), and app.ts installs it via installProxyChannelBufferUsageTelemetry for telemetry reporting, matching the stated investigative goal.
